source_evidence: The v0.2.556 guest native screenshot from workflow 39290491457 shows the global Saved audits unavailable notice at 360x373 while the chat answer is not visible. The sanitized run did not retain the saved-history HTTP status. SEO is public, but SeoView automatically queried the account-owned extend.wbx_seo_audit table. The query had no guest token preflight, and failDbCall published the refusal in the panel-wide NoticeHost. The notice tray is mounted outside the tabs and reserves up to 40% of panel height, so the notice persists when switching to Chat until dismissed. This establishes the cross-tab notice and lost space; it does not establish the cause of the invisible chat reply.
sibling_census: The public DataView likewise queried account-owned wbx_pattern rows on mount; its guest path now skips that read while preserving field picking. useAutoExtract already gates its saved-pattern read on authentication. fetchLatestSeoAuditForUrl has no callers; signed-in saved-capture surfaces were outside this guest defect.
repair: Saved SEO history now checks the canonical stored bearer and distinguishes sign-in-required from genuinely empty history. SeoView skips the guest read, reloads on sign-in and clears account history on sign-out. DataView skips the guest saved-pattern read and reloads on sign-in. Signed-in history database refusals still raise the existing notice and retry state. Public live SEO audit and Data field picking remain available.
red_green: Before the repair, the new SEO guest regression failed because the token preflight was never called; the Data guest regression failed because fetchPatternsForDomain was called once. After the repair, the focused suite passed 32/32 tests, including signed-in refusal and sign-in/sign-out transitions.
